charcuterie: Nustrale pork, chestnuts, mountain air. And time, lots of it.
fromages: Raw ewe's and goat's milk. Strong characters.
vins-spiritueux: Niellucciu, sciaccarellu, vermentinu. Grapes you'll only find here.
